# Pharos Design System

> Design system da Alexandria — componentes React acessíveis, temas e templates.
> Pacotes npm: @pharos-ds/core, @pharos-ds/theme-pharos, @pharos-ds/cli

## Docs
- /docs/instalacao — Instalação e setup
- /docs/nextjs — Integração Next.js App Router
- /docs/cli — CLI e API programática
- /docs/temas — Temas e dark mode
- /docs/estilizacao — className, CSS, Tailwind
- /docs/tokens — Design tokens
- /docs/agentes — Guia para AI agents

## Surfaces
- /componentes — Galeria de componentes
- /componentes/{Name} — Props, demos e boas práticas
- /templates — Templates de página
- /temas — Theme Pharos

## Agent instructions
1. Use `npx @pharos-ds/cli init` once per project
2. Never guess component APIs — run `npx @pharos-ds/cli component <Name>`
3. Prefer composed Pharos components over hand-rolled CSS
4. Install: `@pharos-ds/core` + `@pharos-ds/theme-pharos`
5. CSS order: reset.css → pharos.css → theme.css
6. Wrap app with `<Theme theme={pharosTheme}>` from `@pharos-ds/theme-pharos/built`
7. DEFAULT THEME IS ALWAYS `@pharos-ds/theme-pharos` (Alexandria brand). Since `@pharos-ds/cli` 1.0.3, `pharos init` installs and wires it by default; older CLI versions suggested `@pharos-ds/theme-neutral` — ignore that and upgrade. Never install `theme-neutral` or other `@pharos-ds/theme-*` packages.
